name: Trellis
description: Trellis - Claude for Trial Court Litigators gives Claude direct access to the largest state trial court dataset in the U.S. — including dockets, rulings, verdicts, and filings — enabling legal research, judge and opposing counsel analytics, expert witness vetting, and motion drafting grounded in real precedent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trellis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trellis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trellis.law/anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trellis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trellis lists 24 MCP tools, including get_server_instructions, list_skills, get_skill, Search-get_server_instructions, Analytics-get_server_instructions, Search-search_cases, Search-get_case, Search-get_case_complaints, Search-search_documents, Search-get_document, Search-search_rulings, and Search-get_ruling.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trellis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trellis in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Trellis requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trellis is developed by Trellis. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
